scope.description: Twelve trials on hand-built four-node clusters whose nodes all share 50ms settings and all have PreVoteDisabled set: one voter is isolated first and left to campaign, which with pre-vote off raises its term, and only then are the leader and the nonvoter isolated from the two remaining voters while the leader's verifications are polled and the two voters watched for a leader.
assumptions: PreVoteDisabled is a public configuration field, so disabling pre-vote is a supported deployment choice rather than an artificial one; it is the configuration that separates the two gates the earlier run could not distinguish.
The candidate's term is recorded before and after the isolation so the run shows whether a higher-term candidacy formed.
Verification is driven through the same channel the exported API uses; a competing leader is detected by reading the two isolated nodes' states.
The dry run is native feedback only; the retained execution is what will be interpreted.
excluded: No on-disk store, no network transport, no multi-process execution.
Only the uniform configuration with pre-vote off is exercised here.

parameters.trials: 12 adverse trials with pre-vote disabled (trial ids 0-11)
parameters.recorded_operands: adverse, preexisting_candidate, campaigner_state, campaigner_term, leader_term, polls, confirmations, last_confirmation_ms, first_peer_leader_ms, confirmations_after_peer_leader, confirmation_after_peer_leader, leader_stepped_down

basis.prefix: The harness is the adverse-phase probe with one change: every node's Config has PreVoteDisabled set, and only the twelve adverse trials run. Each trial builds four nodes by hand with identical settings, waits for a leader, forces leadership onto node 0, demotes node 3 to nonvoter, records a baseline confirmation and one applied command, isolates node 1 and waits up to three seconds for it to report Candidate with a term above the leader's, then isolates the leader and the nonvoter from both remaining voters and polls the verification path every 2ms while watching those voters for a leader, emitting a summary event per trial with the counts, the campaigner's state and term, the leader's term and whether any confirmation followed a competing leader.

comparisons.description: Prediction under test: with pre-vote disabled and a higher-term candidacy alive, at least one confirmation follows a competing leader. Trials that fail it are witnesses that the known-leader gate and the timers keep the separation without pre-vote.
